errors.evidence: The outer ring (2021) for Kultur is approximately 2.4%, not 2.2%. The description incorrectly assigns the 2014 value to 2021.
The inner ring (2014) for Sport/Erholung is 2.4%, not 4.1%. The description incorrectly assigns the 2021 value to 2014.
The inner ring (2014) for Wohnungswesen is 4.1%, not 8.4%. The description incorrectly assigns the 2021 value trend to 2014.
The inner ring (2014) for Übrige Versorgung is 1.4%, not 4.1%. The description incorrectly assigns the Wohnungswesen 2014 value to Übrige Versorgung.
The Verkehr segment is grey, not magenta. The description incorrectly maps the color.
The Wirtschaftsförderung segment is a single shade of light green, not olive. The description introduces an incorrect color variant.
The Kombinierte Versorgung segment is light red (hellrot), not light purple (hellviolett).
The Abfallwirtschaft segment is light purple (helllila), not violet. The description uses an incorrect color synonym.
The description does not explicitly state that the segments are labeled directly, though it implies it. Missing clear mention of segment labeling style.
The description states 14 segments, but the figure shows 13 distinct categories (excluding the ring separation). This is misleading.
